$comment: Kind-level defaults for plugins built with `bun run add-plugin --kind openhands`: a LOCAL kind, the client starts the MCP server (npx) and it holds the person's key. Placeholders: {{TITLE}} {{SERVER}} {{DESCRIPTION}} {{PACKAGE}} {{MAJOR}} {{NETWORK}}. Claude Code expands ${VAR:-default} in .mcp.json env, so a person can switch network with OPENHANDS_NETWORK; the portable mcp.json (Codex) has no env expansion, so its value is literal. Since 2026-10-13 (the red-team gate MC6 passed) mainnet needs no flag: the server's caps, previews and confirmations are the guard on both networks.
description: Find paid work, post asks and hire people and agents on {{TITLE}}, with your own key held on your machine.
